## ec23789c7821

**Reproduced teaching-domain defect: ordinary data never demonstrates preservation of non-target cells.** Generator SHA-256 is `4ca6a3130cf0064bd6c3d0e6a87e4ced3a80054c307fe093b17c4d5b8d16df97`; executed rule hash is `281bfb5a3049` (rule-text SHA-256 `054d0872a06455b88e72bc26d43a3e4b9306d91af5cf7619f25eeab2e52ea462`).

I sampled 200 default grids in each of easy, medium, and hard using seeds 0–199 and `sample_index=seed*17+5`. All **600/600** grids contained only isolated horizontal same-color length-3 components: 2,372 target components and **0 other components** (`checks/audit/ec23789c7821/domain-probe.json`). Therefore the plausible rival “construct the output only from recognized length-3 targets and discard every other input cell” is observationally identical on every sampled ordinary input.

The generator's own advertised `texture=run_too_short` provides a decisive counterexample. With seed 0/sample 0 it emits two horizontal length-2 runs. The canonical Racket rule preserves the input exactly, while the target-only rival returns a blank grid (`checks/audit/ec23789c7821/counterexample.json`, with full input/Racket/rival outputs beside it). This input belongs to the documented explicit texture domain and was produced by the target generator; the target defines no `self_check`, so no validator verdict exists.

**Additional reproduced contract issues.** Standalone lint fails because `RULE_HASH` and `self_check` are missing. The override stage rejects the advertised `grid_h=5` in easy mode and reports thousands of related mismatches (`checks/audit/ec23789c7821/lint/checks/ec23789c7821_after_lint.log`, `checks/audit/ec23789c7821/override/checks/ec23789c7821_after_override.log`).

**Suggested repair, not applied.** Mix preserved singletons/short/long runs into ordinary grids, add a target-only rival and witness contract, pin the authority hash, add a lawful validator, and make each advertised axis exact or explicitly diagnostic.
